content: Pohl Kohla Serusalem
Eri, se ahpw rahnmwahwihirailla oh mwesel. Mwurin at serek kohkohla, se ahpw lel Kos, oh mandahn rahno se lel Rohdes; oh sang wasao se ahpw douluhllahng Patara.
Se ahpw diarada wasao sohp pwoat me pahn kolahng Penisia, kiht eri iangada.
Se senserek kohla se lao kilangada Saiprus, kiht eri sereklahng palieir en Saiprus oh douluhllahng Siria. Se ahpw peidi ni oaroahr en Dair, wasa me sohpo pahn kihsang ie kanenge.
Se tuhwong ekei me pwoson wasao, oh se mihmihki rehrail erein wihk ehu. Sang ni kaweid en Ngehn Sarawi, re ahpw padahkihong Pohl en dehr kohla Serusalem.

Ni eh lel ahnsoun at mwesel, se ahpw mweselsang irail. Irail koaros, iangahki arail pwoud kan oh neirail seri kan, ahpw pil iangkitada sang nan kahnimwo. Kiht koaros ahpw kelehpwikihdi pohn oaroahro oh kapakap.
Kiht eri rahnmwahwih emenemen irail oh karadahng pohn sohpo; re ahpw pwurala ni imwarail kan.
Se usehlahte at seiloak, seiloaksang Dair kolahng Tolemeis, wasa me se rahnmwahwih riat me pwoson akan oh mihmih rehrail rahn ehu.

Mandahn rahno se ahpw mwesel oh lel Sesaria. Wasao se ahpw kohla ni imwen Pilip me kin iang kalohki rongamwahu; kiht eri koukousoan reh. Iei ih emen kisehn ohl isimen me pilipildahr en iang wia sounsawas nan Serusalem.
Mie nah serepein kiripw pahmen, me kin padapadahngkiseli mahsen en Koht.
Ni at mihmihkiher wasao erein rahn ekei; soukohp emen, ede Akapwus, ahpw kohdo sang Sudia.

E kohdo reht, oh ale en Pohl eh katengo, e ahpw pein pirekipene neh oh peh kan, oh nda, “Iet me Ngehn Sarawi mahsanih: Iet duwen me mehn Suhs akan pahn wiahiong aramas me ahneki kateng wet nan Serusalem; oh re pil pahn pangala rehn mehn liki kan.”
Eri, ni at rongehr met, kiht, oh irail kan me mi wasao, ahpw peki rehn Pohl en dehr kohla Serusalem.
Pohl ahpw sapengki, “Dahme kumwail sengisengki oh kauwehkilahr mohngiongi? I onopadahr, kaidehn ongete en selidi nan Serusalem, ahpw ong mehla, pwehki Kaun Sises.”
Eri, pwehki at sohte kak wia mehkot en wekidala eh lamalam, se ahpw nda, “Eri, kupwur en Kaun-o en pweida.”
Mwurin at koukousoankiher wasao erein ahnsou kis, se ahpw kaunopada at kepwe kan oh mwesellahng Serusalem.
Ekei tohnpadahk en Sesaria pil iangkitada, oh kahreikitalahng ni ihmw ehu, wasa me se pahn kousoan ie, imwen ohl emen me adaneki Neison, mehn Saiprus; ohl menet pwosonlahr sangete nin tapio.
Pohl Tuhwong Seims
Ni ahnsou me se lelohng nan Serusalem, riat me pwosonlahr ko inenen kasamwo kiht mwahu mehlel.
Mandahn rahno Pohl ahpw iangkitada pwe en kolahng tuhwong Seims, oh irail me mah kan en mwomwohdiso pil iang mi wasao.
Pohl eri rahnmwahwih irail oh koasoiaiong irail soahng koaros me Koht ketin wiahier nanpwungen mehn liki kan ni eh wie doadoahk rehrail.
Ni ar rong, irail koaros ahpw kapinga Koht. Irail eri ndaiong Pohl, “Riat Pohl, se men komwi en wehwehki met: mehn Suhs tohto me pwosonlahr, oh irail koaros inenen poadidiong Kosonnedo.

Irail rongehr me komw kin padapadahkihong mehn Suhs kan me koukousoan nan en mehn liki kan ar wehi en kesehla Kosonned en Moses, oh pil koasoiaiong irail re en dehr sirkumsaisihala neirail seri kan de pil idawehn tiahk kan en mehn Suhs.
Irail uhdahn pahn rong me komwi leledohr. Eri, dahme pahn wiawi?
Komw wia dahme se pahn ndaiong komwi. Ohl pahmen mihmih met me wiadahr inou ehu.
Eri, komw pahn iangirailla wia kasarawien kamwakel, oh pwainla pweinarail kan. Eri, re ahpw pahn kak koakoahsang pitenmoangarail kan.
Eri, ni mwekid wet aramas koaros pahn esehki me soahng kan me irail rongehr duwen komwi me likamw, pwe pein komwi kin idawehn tiahk en Kosonned en Moses.

A duwen mehn liki me pwosonlahr akan, se kadaralahngirailehr kisinlikou kis oh koasoiaiong irail me se koasoanedier duwen arail sohte pahn kang mwenge me kin meirong ong dikedik en eni kan, de nta, de mahn me mwopwula, oh duwen arail pahn kanahieng pein irail sang nenek.”

Pohl eri kahrehda ohl ako, oh pweidi songada e ahpw iang irail wiahda kasarawien kamwakel. E ahpw pedolong nan Tehnpas Sarawio, oh pakairki duwen arail ahnsoun kamwakel en imwisekla mwurin rahn ekei, oh ni ahnsowo en emenemen meirong ahpw pahn wiawi.
Pohl Kolkoldi nan Tehnpas Sarawio
Eri, rahn isuh en kamwakelo eh kereniongehr imwisekla, ekei mehn Suhs akan sang wehin Eisia ahpw kilangada Pohl nan Tehnpas Sarawio. Re ahpw kamwoarongehda pokono pwon oh koledi Pohl.

Irail eri weriwerki, “Ohlen Israel kan! Kumwail sewesei kiht! Iei ohl menet me kin kohseli wasa koaros oh kin kaukauwe mehn Israel oh Kosonned en Moses, oh pil Tehnpas Sarawi wet. Oh met e pil kahrehlong ekei mehn liki nan Tehnpas Sarawi oh kasaminehkilahr wasa sarawi wet!”
(Irail nda met pwehki ar kilang Tropimus mehn Episos eh ieiang Pohl nan kahnimwo, oh re ahpw kihkihong me Pohl kahrehlong nan Tehnpas Sarawio.)
Pingiping laud ahpw kipehdi nan kahnimwo pwon, oh aramas akan ahpw tangpene oh koledi Pohl oh wuruhdekihieisang nan Tehnpas Sarawio. Ni ahnsowohte re ahpw ritingedi wenihmwen Tehnpas Sarawio.
Pwihno ahpw songosong en kemehla Pohl; oh ni ahnsowo pakair ahpw kolahng kaunen sounpei en Rom me dene moromor wiewiawi nan Serusalem pwon.
Ni ahnsowohte kaunen sounpeio ahpw kahrehda opiser kei oh sounpei kei, oh mwadangdilahng pokono. Ni aramas ako ar kilangada ohlo, iangahki sounpei kan, re ahpw tokedihsang keme Pohl.
Kaunen sounpeio eri kohla rehn Pohl oh koledi, oh ruwese en selkihdi selmete riapwoat. E ahpw idek, “Ihs ohl menet, oh dahme e wiadahr?”

Eri, ekei nan pokono weriwerki ehu soahng, a ekei ehu soahng. Me inenen ping me kahrehiong kaunen sounpeio eh sohte kak dehdehki dahme wiawihero. Ih eri ndaiong nah sounpei ko re en kahrelahng Pohl nan kelen sounpeio.
Irail eri kahrelahng Pohl ni kehndake ko, oh sounpei ko ahpw wahda Pohl,
pwehki pwihnen moromoro ar pwakipwakih oh weriwerki, “En kamakamala!”
Pohl Pein Doare Ih
Ni ar kereniongehr pedolong nan kelen sounpeio, Pohl ahpw ndaiong kaunen sounpeio, “E kak mweiong ie I en koasoiong komwi?” Kaunen sounpeio ahpw idek, “Ke ese lokaiahn Krihs?
Eri, kaidehn kowe ohlen Isipo, me tapihada mwekid en moromor ehu oh kaundahr sounkam aramas pahkid nan sapwtehno?”
Pohl ahpw sapengki, “Ngehi mehn Suhs, I ipwidi nan Tarsus en Silisia, uhdahn towe mehlel en kahnimw kesempwalo. Menlau mweidohng ie I en koasoi ong aramas pwukat.”
Kaunen sounpeio ahpw mweidohng. Pohl eri kesihnenda pohn kehndake ko oh oaloallahng aramas ako; oh ni ar meleileidier, e ahpw koasoia ong irail ni mahsen en Ipru:
